info.title: ZippyGo Platform API
info.description: HTTP API of the ZippyGo platform: ordering, dispatch, fleet and commerce for on-demand delivery.

get.summary:
The public keys access tokens are signed with (RFC 7517), for local verification by the
apps and future services.
Liveness probe: the process is up and serving requests. Does not touch dependencies.

The catalogue entry for a problem code: its title, status, whether retrying can help, a
description and the field-level codes it may carry. Every problem's `type` resolves here.

Readiness probe: every store is reachable. Returns 503 with the same body otherwise, so load
balancers stop routing traffic here until the dependency recovers.

The audit log, newest first, in pages. Platform staff read every entry; a partner member
reads the entries of a partner they belong to by naming it. Filterable by actor, target,
action and period, with the full grammar in `filter`.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Only acts on this record id

parameters.name: target_kind
parameters.description: Only acts on records of this kind

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Only records of this partner; required for partner members

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only acts at or after this RFC 3339 instant

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only acts at or before this RFC 3339 instant

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter tree as JSON; see GET /v1/audit-log/filters

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort keys, comma separated, `-` for descending (default `-occurred_at`)

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Enumeration fields to count, comma separated

400.description: A parameter was refused; `errors` names each

403.description: A partner member without a partner named

404.description: A partner the caller does not belong to

get.summary: The fields the audit log can be filtered, sorted and faceted by.
One entry.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: The partner the entry belongs to; required for partner members

403.description: A partner member without a partner named

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary:
Requests a one-time code by email or SMS. Always accepted for a well-formed identifier, so
nothing reveals whether an account exists; the user is created on the first verification.
Limited per identifier and per client address.

202.description: A code is on its way

409.description: `sign_in_closed`: the number's country is not accepting sign-in

503.description: A store or the delivery provider is unavailable

post.summary:
Exchanges a one-time code for tokens. Five wrong codes lock the challenge
(`too_many_attempts`); an unknown, used or expired challenge is `code_expired`.

200.description: Signed in; browsers also receive the `zg_refresh` cookie

post.summary:
Sets the password of the signed-in user. The current password is required once one is set
(`forbidden` when missing or wrong). Other sessions of the user are revoked.

403.description: The user has a password and `current_password` is missing or wrong

post.summary:
Email and password sign-in. Unknown accounts and wrong passwords are both `unauthenticated`,
in the same time.

200.description: Signed in; browsers also receive the `zg_refresh` cookie

post.summary:
Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. Browsers send the cookie; native
clients send `refresh_token` in the body. Presenting a token that was already rotated
revokes the whole session. When a cookie-borne token is refused, the cookie is cleared.

requestBody.description: Optional; omit it when the cookie carries the token

200.description: New tokens; browsers also receive a new `zg_refresh` cookie

401.description: No token, an unknown or rotated token, or a revoked or expired session

post.summary: Ends the session of the token and clears the cookie.

204.description: Signed out; the `zg_refresh` cookie is cleared

get.summary: One campaign slot.

200.description: The slot, with its version as the `ETag`

delete.summary: Removes a campaign slot and takes it out of every display grid; platform staff.

patch.summary:
Changes a campaign slot; platform staff. Send `If-Match` to be refused when someone else
changed it first.

200.description: The slot after the change, with its new `ETag`

get.summary: Every country.

post.summary: Opens a market: the country is created active with orders and sign-in on; platform staff.

get.summary: One country.

200.description: The country, with its version as the `ETag`

patch.summary:
Changes a country's details; platform staff. Send `If-Match` to be refused when someone
else changed it first.

200.description: The country after the change, with its new `ETag`

put.summary: Names the service area customers who cannot be placed are sent to; platform staff.

400.description: Malformed body, or an area of another country

get.summary: The country's public holidays.

put.summary: Replaces the country's holiday calendar; platform staff.
Turns order taking on or off for the country, with a reason; platform staff.

get.summary: The country's service policy layer, its latest version.

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the country's service policy layer; platform staff.

get.summary: Every version of the country's policy layer, newest first.
The country's schedule layer (its exceptions: the public holidays as closures, when set).

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the country's schedule layer; platform staff.
Turns customer sign-in on or off for the country, with a reason; platform staff.
Moves a country along its lifecycle, with a reason; platform staff.

get.summary: Every currency.

post.summary: Adds a currency; platform staff.

get.summary: One currency.

200.description: The currency, with its version as the `ETag`

patch.summary:
Changes a currency's symbol, locale or status; platform staff. Send `If-Match` to be refused
when someone else changed it first.

200.description: The currency after the change, with its new `ETag`

get.summary:
The newest domain events, newest first. Poll with `after` set to the newest id already seen.
Platform staff see every event; partner members see their partners' events.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only events newer than this event id (exclusive); poll with the newest id seen

get.summary:
Agents with their status and last known position, filterable by partner and status. Platform
staff see every partner; partner members see the partners they belong to.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Only this partner's agents; every readable partner when omitted

404.description: The partner in the query is not one the caller belongs to, answered like an unknown id

post.summary:
Accepts a batch of position reports. Requires the step 0 development credential in
`X-Dev-Api-Key`. Validation problems are 400, unknown agents 422.

400.description: The batch failed validation; `errors` points at each field

422.description: A ping references an agent that does not exist; `errors` points at the pings

get.summary:
Health of the API with the running version and the server time. Unauthenticated; for plain
uptime monitoring. `degraded` when any dependency is impaired or down.

Health of the API and of each dependency: Postgres, Valkey and the event outbox. The overall
status is the worst check; the HTTP status is 200 for `ok` and `degraded`, 503 for `down`,
with the same body.

200.description: The service is ok or degraded

503.description: The service is down; the body names the failing checks

post.summary:
Accepts an invitation by its token: creates the user if needed, creates the membership and
signs the person in (cookie or body as for the sign-in operations).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the invitation email

requestBody.description: Optional; used only when the user is created

200.description: Accepted: the session and the membership

400.description: Malformed body, or a weak password (`password_weak` on `/password`)

get.summary:
Live stream of agent positions and statuses: a `snapshot` frame of every matching agent when
the stream opens, then `position` and `status` frames as they change, plus a `heartbeat`
every 15 seconds. Missed frames are not replayed; reconnect for a fresh snapshot. The access
token goes in the `Authorization` header or, for `EventSource`, in `?access_token=`.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Only this partner's agents; every readable partner when omitted

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The access token, for clients that cannot set the Authorization header (EventSource)

404.description: The partner in the query is not one the caller belongs to, answered like an unknown id

get.summary:
Live stream of domain events as they are published: `event` events carrying an `Event` as
JSON, plus a `heartbeat` every 15 seconds. Platform staff see every event; partner members
see their partners' events. The access token goes in the `Authorization` header or, for
`EventSource`, in `?access_token=`.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The access token, for clients that cannot set the Authorization header (EventSource)

200.description: Server-sent events: `event` frames carrying an Event as JSON, and `heartbeat` every 15 seconds

get.summary: The signed-in user with every membership and their platform roles.

Partners in pages, newest first by default; platform realm only. Filter with the named
parameters or the full grammar in `filter`, sort with up to three declared keys and ask for
facet counts alongside the page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only partners whose name or legal name contains this text

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter tree as JSON; see GET /v1/partners/filters

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort keys, comma separated, `-` for descending (default `-created_at`)

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Enumeration fields to count, comma separated (`status`, `kind`)

400.description: A parameter was refused; `errors` names each with its code

post.summary:
Creates a partner with the caller as its owner. The partner starts `pending`; platform staff
activate it with `PATCH /v1/partners/{partner_id}`.

201.description: The partner, `pending`, with the caller as owner

get.summary:
The fields partners can be filtered, sorted and faceted by, so a console builds its filter
bar from the declaration.

Counts of every partner by status and kind, without fetching rows, from a copy at most 30
seconds old; platform realm only.
One partner, for its members and platform staff.

200.description: The partner, with its version as the `ETag`

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

patch.summary:
Changes the members present in the body. Owners and managers change the profile; only
platform staff change `status`, with a `reason` kept in the audit log. Send `If-Match` with
the version you hold to be refused when someone else changed the partner first.

200.description: The partner after the change, with its new `ETag`

403.description: The role does not allow the change

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

412.description: `If-Match` no longer matches: someone changed the partner first

get.summary: The partner's invitations, newest first; owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary: Invites an email address; owners and managers, and only owners may grant `owner`.

201.description: The invitation; the email is on its way

403.description: Neither owner nor manager, or a manager granting owner

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

409.description: Already a member, or already invited

503.description: A store or mail delivery is unavailable

delete.summary: Revokes a pending invitation; owners and managers.

get.summary: The partner's locations, oldest first.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

post.summary: Adds a location; owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: One location of the partner.

200.description: The location, with its version as the `ETag`

patch.summary:
Changes the members present in the body; owners and managers. Send `If-Match` with the
version you hold to be refused when someone else changed the location first.

200.description: The location after the change, with its new `ETag`

412.description: `If-Match` no longer matches: someone changed the location first

get.summary: The location's own service policy layer, its latest version.

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the location's service policy layer; owners and managers.

get.summary:
The effective policy of the location: the country, the service areas, the partner and the
location folded, every field with the layer and version that supplied it.

200.description: The effective policy with its provenance

get.summary: Every version of the location's policy layer, newest first.
The location's own schedule layer, its latest version.

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the location's schedule layer; owners and managers.

get.summary:
The effective schedule of the location: the nearest week and every exception, in the
location's time zone.
Whether the location trades at an instant and when that changes.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: The instant asked about (RFC 3339); now when omitted

200.description: Open or closed, and until when

get.summary: The partner's members, oldest first.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

delete.summary: Removes a member; owners only, and never the last owner.

409.description: The last owner cannot be removed

get.summary: The partner's service policy layer, its latest version; members and platform staff.

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

put.summary: Saves a new version of the partner's service policy layer; owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: Every version of the partner's policy layer, newest first.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: The partner's schedule layer, its latest version.

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

put.summary:
Saves a new version of the partner's schedule layer (the default week of its locations);
owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: The partner's services, one per kind ever put.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

put.summary: Creates or replaces the service of a kind; owners and managers.

404.description: Unknown, or not visible to the caller

get.summary: The service areas matching the query, by path, so a country's tree reads top down.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Only the children of this area

post.summary:
Adds a service area beneath its parent or at the top of its country; platform staff.
Nothing is created beneath a fenced area: divide it instead.

409.description: The slug exists here, or the parent is fenced

get.summary:
Resolves a pin to a service area: the fenced area containing it, else the nearest serving
area within the cap, else the country's default. Public: the customer app asks before
anybody signs in.

parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: How far a serving area may be, in metres; the platform setting when omitted

get.summary: One service area.

200.description: The area, with its version as the `ETag`

patch.summary:
Renames an area or changes its time zone; platform staff. Send `If-Match` to be refused when
someone else changed it first.

200.description: The area after the change, with its new `ETag`

get.summary: The area's campaign slots, or with `effective` every slot that applies there.

parameters.name: effective
parameters.description: Every slot that applies here, the ancestors' included

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Only the slots showing at this instant (RFC 3339)

post.summary: Adds a campaign slot to the area; platform staff.

get.summary: The area's display grid as served: Verticals no longer offered flagged unavailable.

200.description: The grid; no rows when not composed

put.summary: Replaces the area's display grid, validated against what it offers now; platform staff.

400.description: Malformed body or an invalid composition

post.summary:
Divides a fenced area into fenced children, re-pointing its Locations; platform staff.
Refused with `locations_stranded` unless forced with a reason.

400.description: Malformed body, invalid children, or forcing without a reason

409.description: `locations_stranded`, or the area has no fence

post.summary:
Plans a division without writing: which Locations each child would receive and which would
be stranded; platform staff.

put.summary:
Draws the fence; platform staff. A fence is drawn at one level only: refused when an
ancestor or a descendant is fenced.

400.description: Malformed body or an invalid polygon

409.description: An ancestor or a descendant is fenced

delete.summary:
Removes the fence; platform staff. Refused with `locations_stranded` while Locations sit in
the area.

get.summary: What would stop serving if the area were deactivated.

200.description: The fenced areas beneath and their Locations

post.summary:
Merges the fenced areas beneath an unfenced area back into it, with a reason; platform
staff.

parameters.name: service_area_id
parameters.description: The area the children fold into

200.description: The area with the joined fence

400.description: Malformed body, the children misnamed, or no reason

get.summary: The area's service policy layer, its latest version.

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the area's service policy layer; platform staff.

get.summary: Every version of the area's policy layer, newest first.
The area's schedule layer (exceptions only: closures for the whole area).

200.description: The layer; version 0 when never set

put.summary: Saves a new version of the area's schedule layer; platform staff.

Moves an area along its lifecycle, with a reason; platform staff. Everything beneath
follows.
Sets the order Verticals appear in for the area; platform staff.

200.description: The offers in the new order

400.description: Malformed body, or a Vertical not offered here

get.summary: The Verticals the area offers: declared here or inherited, in its order.

put.summary: Replaces the Verticals the area declares itself; platform staff.

400.description: Malformed body, or an unknown or archived Vertical

get.summary: The closed catalogue of fields a service type may declare.
Every service type.

post.summary: Adds a service type as a draft; platform staff.

get.summary: One service type.

200.description: The service type, with its version as the `ETag`

patch.summary:
Changes a service type; platform staff. Send `If-Match` to be refused when someone else
changed it first.

200.description: The service type after the change, with its new `ETag`

put.summary: Moves a service type along its lifecycle; platform staff.

200.description: The service type after the change

get.summary: Every setting with its value in force, bounds and default.
One setting.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The setting key, such as reference.resolution_cap_metres

404.description: No setting with that key is declared

put.summary: Stores a value within the setting's bounds; platform staff.

404.description: No setting with that key is declared

delete.summary: Removes the stored value so the default is in force again; platform staff.

404.description: No setting with that key is declared

get.summary: The closed catalogue of fields a store type may declare.
Every store type.

post.summary: Adds a store type as a draft; platform staff.

get.summary: One store type.

200.description: The store type, with its version as the `ETag`

patch.summary:
Changes a store type; platform staff. Send `If-Match` to be refused when someone else
changed it first.

200.description: The store type after the change, with its new `ETag`

put.summary: Moves a store type along its lifecycle; platform staff.

200.description: The store type after the change

get.summary: Every Vertical with its categories.

post.summary: Adds a Vertical, active, at the end of the order; platform staff.

get.summary: One Vertical.

200.description: The Vertical, with its version as the `ETag`

patch.summary:
Renames a Vertical; platform staff. Send `If-Match` to be refused when someone else changed
it first.

200.description: The Vertical after the change, with its new `ETag`

put.summary: Replaces a Vertical's categories in merchandising order; platform staff. Ids given are kept.
Sets or clears the image on a Vertical's tile; platform staff.

get.summary: Where a Vertical reaches: every country's tree with the declared and inherited offers.

put.summary: Moves a Vertical along its lifecycle; platform staff. Every open screen re-reads its grid.

Actor.description:
The actor of an entry: the user and the membership they acted as, with the name frozen at
the time.

label.description: The actor's name as it was at the time, when known.

membership_id.description: The membership acted as, when known.

partner_id.description: The partner (or the platform organisation) the membership is in.

state.description: State or region, `null` when not applicable.

AffectedArea.description: One fenced area that would stop serving.

Agent.description: An agent with its presence and last known position, the `Agent` schema.

display_name.description: The name the agent is shown under.

last_seen_at.description: When the agent was last heard from, `null` if never.

partner_id.description: The partner whose service the agent is attached to.

oneOf.description: Last known position, `null` until the first ping.

service_kind.description: The kind of service the agent is attached to.

items.description: The matching agents, by display name. Not paginated.

AgentPosition.description: A position as reported by an agent's device (WGS 84), the `AgentPosition` schema.

heading_deg.description: Direction of travel in degrees clockwise from true north, `null` when not reported.

recorded_at.description: When the position was recorded on the device.

speed_mps.description: Ground speed in metres per second, `null` when not reported.

status.description: The agent's status at the time of the update.

AgentSnapshot.description: Data of the `snapshot` frame that opens `GET /v1/live/agents`.

agents.description: Every agent matching the stream's filter, at the time the stream opened.

AgentStatus.description: The working status of an agent: `online` while location pings keep arriving.

last_seen_at.description: When the agent was last heard from, `null` if never.

AreaKind.description: The kind of a service area: a label only, nothing branches on it.

AuditEntry.description: One entry of the audit log, the `AuditEntry` schema.

after.description: The values after the act, when the act changed something.

approver_user_id.description: The person who approved, for a four-eyes approval.

before.description: The values before the act, when the act changed something.

client_address.description: The client address the request came from, when known.

correlation_id.description: The correlation id of the request.

id.description: Identifier of the entry; entries sort by it.

partner_id.description: The partner the record belongs to; `null` for platform records.

proposer_user_id.description: The person who proposed, for a four-eyes approval.

reason.description: The reason given, where the capability demands one.

AuditEntryList.description: A page of audit entries, the `AuditEntryList` schema.

facets.description: Facet counts, when `facets` was asked for.

items.description: The entries, newest first by default.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, `null` on the last one.

colour.description: Background colour as a hex triplet.

hours.description: Hours of the week it shows; empty means always.

service_area_id.description: The service area it belongs to; applies to everything beneath.

shows_from.description: Shows from this instant; `null` means as soon as it is on.

shows_to.description: Shows until this instant; `null` means until switched off.

white_text_readable.description: Whether white text on the colour is readable (contrast at least 3).

colour.description: Background colour as a lowercase hex triplet.

enabled.description: Whether it is on from the start.

hours.description: Hours of the week it shows; empty means always.

CatalogueBlock.description: What a store type's items may carry, the `CatalogueBlock` schema.

CatalogueCapability.description: What a store type's items may carry.

CatalogueTerm.description: What a store type calls its catalogue.

Channel.description: How a one-time code is delivered.

CheckStatus.description: Outcome of a check: the worst of the checks is the overall status.

Choice.description: A named choice of a setting.

CollectionSummary.description: The summary of a collection, the `CollectionSummary` schema.

accepts_orders.description: Whether its service areas accept orders: is delivery trading.

accepts_sign_in.description: Whether its customers may sign in.

alpha2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, immutable; the natural key service areas reference.

calling_code.description: The calling code without a plus sign; the default when a customer types a local number.

currency.description: The currency quoted, from the allow-list.

default_service_area_id.description: Where a customer whose address cannot be placed is sent; `null` when none.

prices_include_tax.description: The price-law statement: whether displayed prices include tax.

time_zones.description: The IANA time zones the country spans.

calling_code.description: The calling code without a plus sign.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether displayed prices include tax; `true` when omitted.

code.description: The ISO 4217 code; the natural key every amount names, immutable.

display_locale.description: The locale amounts are rendered in.

operating.description: Whether the platform operates in this currency (the allow-list).

status.description: Lifecycle; only an `active` currency may be given to a new country.

symbol_override.description: A symbol used instead of the runtime's, when it cannot format the currency.

display_locale.description: The locale amounts are rendered in.

symbol_override.description: A symbol used instead of the runtime's.
New symbol override, or `null` to clear.

Day.description: A day of the week, as written on the wire.

DaySchedule.description: The windows of one weekday, the `DaySchedule` schema.

open.description: The open windows; empty means closed that day.

DeactivationImpact.description: What would stop serving if an area were deactivated, the `DeactivationImpact` schema.

affected.description: Every fenced area beneath it (itself included when fenced) with its Locations.

DependencyCheck.description: The result of probing one dependency.

latency_ms.description: Round-trip time of the probe in milliseconds; when down, the time until it failed.

DisplayGrid.description: A service area's composition, the `DisplayGrid` schema; empty means not configured.

force.description: Go ahead although Locations would be stranded, deactivating them; needs a reason.

reason.description: Why, kept in the audit log.

DivisionChild.description: A child in a division plan.

ring.description: Its fence as one ring of `[longitude, latitude]` points.

DivisionPlan.description: The outcome of planning or committing a division, the `DivisionPlan` schema.

areas.description: The areas that result (would result, for a dry run), each with the Locations it receives.

EffectivePolicy.description:
The effective policy of a Location, the `EffectivePolicy` schema: per field the value and
the layer that supplied it, with the full chain outermost first.

chain.description: The chain, outermost first, each layer labelled with the version in force.

currency.description: The currency every amount is in.

EffectiveSchedule.description: The effective schedule of a Location, the `EffectiveSchedule` schema.

exceptions.description: Every exception of every layer, outermost first.

time_zone.description: The time zone the times are in.

oneOf.description: The layer whose week is in force.

Event.description:
The envelope of every event, the `Event` schema of the public API. The business data lives in
`payload`; its shape is defined per `type` and `version` in the event catalog.

correlation_id.description: Shared by everything that stems from the same originating action; `null` when unknown.

id.description: Unique, time-ordered event id. Consumers deduplicate on it.

partner_id.description: The partner the event belongs to; `null` for platform-wide events.

payload.description: Event data as defined by `type` and `version`.

version.description: Payload schema version for this type.

EventList.description: A page of events, newest first.

counts.description: One entry per declared value, zero counts included.

FeeBand.description: One band of a fee ladder, the `FeeBand` schema.

up_to.description: The band's upper bound (metres or minor units); `null` for the open-ended last band.

Fence.description:
A fence: one or more polygons, each as its outer ring of `[longitude, latitude]` points,
the `Fence` schema.

rings.description: The polygons' outer rings; each ring is closed (first point repeated last).

items.description: The fields a type may declare.

FieldCodeDocument.description: A field-level code as served by `GET /problems/{code}`.

message.example: The password must be at least 12 characters long.

FieldDefinition.description: A field of the closed catalogue, the `FieldDefinition` schema.

FieldError.description: One invalid field and why it was rejected.

code.description:
A stable code for the field-level problem when the catalogue defines one (for example
`password_weak` under `validation_failed`); omitted otherwise.

message.description: Why the value was rejected, as a sentence.

pointer.description:
JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the offending member of the request body, the query parameter
or header name for problems outside the body, or an empty string for the whole request.

FieldKind.description: The type of a filterable field, which decides the control a console draws.

FieldType.description: The type of a typed extra field.

FilterField.description: One field of a filter declaration, the `FilterField` schema.

kind.description: The type, which decides the control a console draws.

values.description: The closed set of values, for enumerations.

FilterSchema.description: A resource's filter declaration, the `FilterSchema` schema.

default_sort.description: The sort applied when none is given.

campaign_slot_id.description: The campaign slot, for a campaign cell.

column.description: The column it starts at, zero based.

unavailable.description: Served as unavailable when the Vertical no longer trades here; ignored on save.

vertical_id.description: The Vertical, for a Vertical cell.

cells.description: The cells, each naming its column.

kind.description: The kind, which fixes the capacity.

status.description: Always `ok`: if the process can answer, it is alive.

version.description: Server version from the crate manifest.
